audit_items.proof_trace: reduce_outflow calls vector::borrow_mut exactly once at curr_index = (now / seg_duration) % n (L107-108), so only that segment can be mutated; Move's type system prevents aliasing to any other index. Both the stale-slot reset (L109-112) and the saturating subtraction (L114-118) operate exclusively on this single borrowed segment. The now parameter is derived from Sui's consensus-controlled Clock object at entry points (deposit.move:46, repay.move:46), so attackers cannot redirect the index to a different segment.
